title: Page 3
content_zh:
而事实上，在顾惜恩出生之后，公主便带着女儿独自居住在公主府，不许顾景宏再登公主府的门。顾景宏被赶回了顾家，和他那两个由通房丫鬟升级而成的小妾，以及两个庶子一起生活。

按理说，公主的男人是不许纳妾的，顾家人先辱了公主的尊严，公主会恼怒情有可原；可是不孝有三，无后为大，民间的舆论实质上却倾向顾家人，认为公主太小题大做了。

在世间男人的眼里，不管是贪官污吏也好，清流名士也好，大多都认为不能容忍丈夫纳妾宠婢的妻子，就不是好妻子，这种观点最终甚至形成了律法，就是专门针对女子的「七出之条」，七出之四就是「妒」——他们认为妻子善妒就会乱家，就会造成家庭不和，更有害于家族血脉的延续。

在这种「夫为妻纲」的教条束缚下，就算贵为公主的女子，想要一夫一妻也难逃世人的责难。

升平大长公主不甘屈服，最终却是婆媳反目，夫妻离心，只好一人带着女儿在公主府孤独度日。

说到底，这不过是个可怜女子将唯一的女儿托付他人罢了。

而作为被托付者，原平之忽然就涌现了一种责任感——玄昱说他名为纨裤，实则太过心软，早晚会吃亏的，如果遇到一个狡猾的人，会被那人玩弄于手掌之中，所以玄昱不能不管他。

原平之在心底不以为然，想着无论是他爹娘也好，兄长也好，或者皇帝也好，似乎都把他当做了人傻钱多很好欺负的笨蛋，唯恐他被别人占了便宜。

原平之想了想，最终也没有轻易答应公主，只是婉转地回道：「如果硬算起来，我和顾小姐也算远亲，就算我们不做夫妻，我也会照顾她的。」

公主的脸色一沉，明显对他这种敷衍的回答不满意。

原平之见到公主眼底的无奈与绝望，咬咬牙补充道：「顾小姐目前毕竟还小，完婚还要几年，如果到时候我们真做了夫妻，我必不会负她。」

话已说到这个地步，公主也知道已经是赶鸭子上架难为了人家，她点点头，说：「虽然我是慈母心肠，为了自家女儿打算，可毕竟难为了你。最终选择你的是惜恩，不是我，所以不管以后如何，我也不会怨恨你的。你能此时答应照顾惜恩，我已经很感激了。」

因为升平大长公主的特立独行，她在金陵的贵族交际圈子里并不太受欢迎，能够求救的人实在屈指可数。

自己大限已到，想想日后孤单的女儿，倔强了一生的公主忍不住默默垂泪。

第2章(1)

原平之以为自己和顾惜恩的婚事还有可商量的时间和余地，可他万没想到，他刚从公主府被放出来，回家面对的就是原府的披红挂绿，张灯结彩，大红喜字红通通几乎闪瞎了他的眼。

他问书童银子：「府里有什么喜事？」

银子傻乎乎地摇头，说：「小的不知道。」

随从金子东窜西跑，四下打听消息，然后又气喘吁吁地跑到原平之面前，满面带笑道：「恭喜少爷，贺喜少爷，原来是您的新婚大喜啊。」

原平之伸手打了他一个后脑勺，「说什么鬼话？本少爷大喜，本人却不知？」

侍卫邵五捏着下巴，严肃认真地分析道：「据属下观察，应该是大长公主逼婚了，趁着她还有口气在，赶着把女儿嫁过来，生米煮成熟饭，少爷也就没有后路可退了。」

原平之点头，说：「还是小五言之有理，表哥的手下果然不是白吃饭的。」

银子和金子一起抗议，齐声道：「难道我们就是白吃饭的？」

原平之唾弃道：「废话少说，快跟少爷我瞧瞧热闹去！」

金子不甘地小声嘟囔：「只怕这热闹不是好瞧的。」

邵五摇摇头，看少爷这主人当的，没半点威风，难怪谁都爱欺负他，小妻子都被人硬送上门了，还不当一回事呢。

原府，藤萝馆。

夜已渐深，喧嚣了一天的原府也逐渐安静下来，只有外院待客的大厅里还有不少的奴仆在快手快脚地收拾着残羹剩饭。

今日是原四少爷的新婚大喜之日，虽然婚礼举办得突然，但是京城人士就是消息灵通，随着婚礼的举行，达官贵人与富商名绅陆陆续续地携着贺礼前来，明明都是仓卒赶来，唯恐错过了巴结原府的大好机会，走到了原府门前时，却都显得那么不慌不忙，举止得体，让那些看热闹的人赞叹不已，暗道：这才是大人物啊，送礼都送得这么从容气派。

虽说送礼人士被喜讯炸了个措手不及，但是最受打击的还是原四公子本人，直到现在夜已深沉，原平之坐在洞房里，还觉得恍恍惚惚宛如梦中——今天这一天对于他来说，居然比过去二十年都充实忙碌。

在最早被强行「请」到大长公主府时，原平之还一副优闲模样，虽然被告知他已经「被订婚」了，多了个未婚妻，他也并未太放在心上，因为他觉得顾惜恩才十二岁，当然不可能立刻成亲。而若大长公主随后过世，顾惜恩要守孝，最起码又能拖延三年，这三年里他如果觉得小丫头不合自己的心意，总有一百零一种方法退亲，反正最后他帮着小丫头找个好夫婿就是了，又没有亲口承诺那夫婿一定得是自己。

可是事情怎么突然就急转直下，失去控制了呢？

原平之从大长公主府返回原府后，立刻就被喜娘拖去梳洗换装，红艳艳的新郎服穿上身，他才意识到自己很可能掉进了一个大陷阱里，这个陷阱肯定是他的爹娘与皇帝，还有大长公主联手设计的，目的就是打他个措手不及，在他反应不过来时，硬逼着他娶新娘拜花堂，快刀斩乱麻，生米煮成熟饭，让他想反抗都没时间做准备。

没办法，谁叫他过去有太多不良记录，原府从他十三岁开始议亲，亲自被他搞砸了的亲事就不下十几桩，他爹娘实在是受不了这个「任性妄为」的儿子了。再加上他今年已过了戴冠，真真正正的成年了，却还在秦楼楚馆流连嬉戏，原北顾与郑氏两人大概是狠下了心要收收儿子的性子，让他先「成家」，之后再慢慢考虑「立业」的问题。

说起来，原北顾与郑氏真的很宠爱这个嫡幼子，原平之不想成亲，看不上一般的姑娘，就任凭他挑挑拣拣这么多年，但是父母的耐心总是有限度，不会任由他一辈子这样挑拣下去，当他无法替自己选择一个合适的妻子时，父母就在忍无可忍时果断出手了。

原平之揉了揉眉心，今天他就像个陀螺似的被人支使着东转西转，完全没了自己的主张，就算中途想开溜，也被原府的侍卫们给拦住。这一整天，迎亲、拜堂、陪酒、送客，从早忙到晚，可把一直养尊处优的四公子累坏了，现在他瘫坐在洞房里的大靠背椅上，闭着眼睛动也不想动，只觉得连手指头都是麻木的。

身体的疲惫还在其次，拜自幼勤练武艺的福，他的体力还是不错的，最重要的是脑袋里一团混乱，精神上的疲惫才让人难受。

就这样成亲了？

和一个面都没见过几次、才刚满十二岁的黄毛小丫头？

这让一向在秦楼楚馆号称「风月小霸王」的四公子情何以堪啊？以后见了他的那些狐朋狗友还不笑话死他？
content_en:
In fact, after Gu Xien was born, the princess took her daughter to live alone in the princess mansion, and Gu Jinghong was not allowed to visit the princess mansion again.Gu Jinghong was driven back to the Gu family and lived with his two concubines who were upgraded from maidservants in the same house, and his two concubines.

It stands to reason that the princess's man is not allowed to take concubines. The Gu family has insulted the princess' dignity first, so the princess is understandably angry. However, there are three kinds of unfilial piety, and the worst is not having children. In fact, the public opinion is in favor of the Gu family, thinking that the princess is making too much fuss.

In the eyes of men in the world, whether they are corrupt officials or celebrities, most of them believe that a wife who cannot tolerate her husband taking concubines and doting on maids is not a good wife. This view eventually even formed a law, which is the "Seven Outcomes" specifically for women. Four of the seven outbursts are "jealousy" - they believe that a jealous wife will disrupt the family, cause family disharmony, and be harmful to the continuation of the family bloodline.

Under this dogma of "the husband is the guide for the wife", even a woman who is a princess cannot escape the condemnation of the world if she wants to be monogamous.

The eldest princess Shengping was unwilling to give in, but in the end her mother-in-law and daughter-in-law turned against each other. The couple separated, and they had to live alone in the princess mansion with their daughter.

In the final analysis, this is just a poor woman entrusting her only daughter to others.

As an entrusted person, Yuan Pingzhi suddenly felt a sense of responsibility - Xuan Yu said that he was called Danpants, but in fact he was too soft-hearted and would suffer sooner or later. If he met a cunning person, he would be manipulated by that person, so Xuan Yu could not ignore him.

Yuan Pingzhi disagreed in his heart, thinking that whether it was his parents, brother, or emperor, they all seemed to regard him as a fool who was stupid and rich and could be easily bullied, lest he be taken advantage of by others.

Yuan Pingzhi thought for a while, but in the end he did not easily agree to the princess. He just replied tactfully: "If you count, Miss Gu and I can be considered distant relatives. Even if we are not husband and wife, I will take care of her."

The princess's face darkened, obviously dissatisfied with his perfunctory answer.

Seeing the helplessness and despair in the princess's eyes, Yuan Pingzhi gritted his teeth and added: "Miss Gu is still young after all, and it will take a few years to get married. If we really become husband and wife by then, I will not let her down."

Having reached this point, the princess also knew that it was hard to do anything for others. She nodded and said, "Although I am a loving mother and have plans for my daughter, it is still difficult for you. It was Xi'en who chose you in the end, not me, so no matter what happens in the future, I will not resent you. I am very grateful that you can agree to take care of Xi'en at this time."

Because of the maverick nature of Princess Shengping, she was not very popular in the aristocratic social circle of Jinling, and there were only a handful of people who could ask for help.

Her time has come, and thinking about her daughter who will be lonely in the future, the princess who has been stubborn all her life cannot help crying silently.

Chapter 2(1)

Yuan Pingzhi thought that there was still time and room for negotiation between himself and Gu Xien's marriage, but he never expected that he had just been released from the Princess's Mansion, and what he would see when he returned home was the Yuan Mansion's red and green decorations, lanterns and festoons, and the bright red "Happy" words almost blinded him.

He asked the scholar Yin Zi: "What happy event is happening in the house?"

Yinzi shook his head stupidly and said, "I don't know."

Following Jin Zi, he ran around here and there, asking for news, and then he ran up to Yuan Pingzhi out of breath, saying with a smile on his face: "Congratulations, young master, congratulations, young master, it turns out to be your wedding."

Yuan Pingzhi stretched out his hand and hit him on the back of the head, "What nonsense are you talking about? This young master is overjoyed, but he doesn't know it?"

Shao Wu, the guard, pinched his chin and analyzed seriously: "According to my subordinates' observation, it was probably the eldest princess who forced the marriage. While she was still alive, she hurriedly married her daughter over, and the young master had no way out."

Yuan Pingzhi nodded and said, "Xiao Wu's words are still reasonable. My cousin's men really don't eat for free."

Silver and gold protested together, saying in unison: "Are we just eating for free?"

Yuan Pingzhi spat at him and said, "Stop talking nonsense, come and see the excitement, young master!"

Jin Zi reluctantly muttered in a low voice: "I'm afraid this excitement is not good to see."

Shao Wu shook his head. Seeing that the young master was the master, he didn't have any prestige at all. No wonder everyone liked to bully him. His little wife was even sent to his door, and he didn't take it seriously.

Yuanfu, Wengluo Pavilion.

The night was getting late, and the Yuan Mansion, which had been noisy all day, gradually became quiet. Only in the hall in the outer courtyard where guests were entertained, there were still many servants quickly picking up the leftovers.

Today is the wedding day of the former fourth young master. Although the wedding was held suddenly, people in the capital were well-informed. As the wedding was held, dignitaries and wealthy businessmen and gentry came one after another with congratulatory gifts. They all arrived in a hurry.For fear of missing the great opportunity to curry favor with the Yuan Mansion, when they walked to the door of the Yuan Mansion, they all seemed so unhurried and well-behaved, which made those watching the excitement marvel and secretly thought: This is a big shot, and he gives gifts so calmly and gracefully.

Although the gift-givers were caught off guard by the good news, the one who was most shocked was the Fourth Young Master Yuan himself. Until now, the night was deep, and Yuan Pingzhi was sitting in the bridal chamber, still feeling in a trance, like he was in a dream - today was actually more fulfilling and busier for him than in the past twenty years.

When he was first forcibly "invited" to the eldest princess's mansion, Yuan Pingzhi looked leisurely. Although he was told that he was "engaged" and had a fiancée, he didn't take it too seriously because he felt that Gu Xi'en was only twelve years old and of course it was impossible to get married immediately.And if the eldest princess passes away later, Gu Xien will be able to delay his filial piety for at least three more years. During these three years, if he feels that the little girl is not what he wants, there are always one hundred and one ways to cancel the engagement. Anyway, in the end, he will just help the little girl find a good husband, and he has not personally promised that the husband must be himself.

But why did things suddenly take a turn for the worse and get out of control?

After Yuan Pingzhi returned from the eldest princess's mansion, he was immediately dragged by Xi Niang to freshen up and change clothes. He put on the red groom's clothes, and then he realized that he might have fallen into a big trap. This trap must have been jointly designed by his parents, the emperor, and the eldest princess. The purpose was to catch him off guard. When he couldn't react, they forced him to marry the bride and worship the flower hall. They cut the knot with a knife and cooked the rice, leaving him no time to prepare for resistance.

There was nothing he could do about it. He had too many bad records in the past. The Yuan family started discussing marriages when he was thirteen years old, and he personally messed up more than a dozen marriages. His parents really couldn't stand this "willful" son.In addition, he has passed the crowning this year and has truly become an adult, but he is still hanging around and playing in the Chu Pavilion of Qinlou. Yuan Beigu and Zheng were probably determined to control their son's temperament and let him "get married" first, and then slowly think about "establishing a career".

Speaking of which, Yuan Beigu and Zheng really doted on their youngest son. Yuan Pingzhi didn't want to get married and looked down on ordinary girls, so they let him pick and choose for so many years. However, his parents' patience always had limits and they would not let him continue to choose like this for the rest of his life. When he couldn't choose a suitable wife for himself, his parents took action decisively when they couldn't bear it anymore.

Yuan Pingzhi rubbed his eyebrows. Today, he was being pushed around like a top. He had no idea of ​​his own. Even if he wanted to run away in the middle, he was stopped by the guards of the Yuan Mansion.This whole day of welcoming the bride, visiting the court, accompanying guests with drinks, and seeing off guests, from morning to night, has exhausted the fourth young master who has always been pampered. Now he is slumped on the big back chair in the bridal chamber, with his eyes closed and not wanting to move. He only feels that even his fingers are numb.

The physical exhaustion was secondary. Thanks to his diligent martial arts training since childhood, his physical strength was still good. The most important thing was that his mind was in chaos, and the mental exhaustion was uncomfortable.

Just got married like this?

With a yellow-haired little girl who has just turned twelve years old and has only met a few times?

How can this make the Fourth Young Master, who has always been known as the "Feng Yue Little Overlord" in Qin Lou Chu Pavilion, feel embarrassed?Won't those friends who meet him in the future laugh at him to death?
